subject: Post-demo compliance recap & evidence + DPA / pen test asks
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@kilnpay.com>
Cc: Dirk Roos <dirk.roos@kilnpay.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo compliance recap & evidence + DPA / pen test asks
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so your security team can triage: 

Summary of pain / goals we heard
- Regulatory: KilnPay needs strong evidence around data retention and audit logs for card-processing transactions (12+ months).
- Risk posture: require SOC 2 Type II or equivalent, and an operational pen test report (redacted is acceptable).
- Data handling: require DPA language that calls out subprocessor list and retention maximums; KMS integration is ideal.

What Redwood will provide (next 48 hours)
- SOC 2 summary report and control mapping (attached)
- Short note describing audit log retention options and how to export logs (JSON export + S3 retention lifecycle).
- Draft DPA redline we typically share for customers (DocuSign link once you confirm).

Your asks / outstanding items for KilnPay
1) Can security share the vendor questionnaire (if you prefer, we can ingest the PDF and highlight answers) — you mentioned sending a PDF today.
2) Can Dirk share the required log retention window and whether exfiltration-suspect events need immutable retention?
3) For the pen test: if you can share a redacted copy of the latest report (we only need high-level findings + remediation status), we can map mitigations to our controls.

Immediate next steps and owners
- Laura: send vendor questionnaire and confirm final retention period (due Wed, Oct 7).
- Grace (me): upload SOC 2 summary and retention note to shared Drive; send draft DPA (DocuSign) once KilnPay confirms minor clause on subprocessor notification.
- Dirk: indicate whether KilnPay requires monthly or quarterly audit log exports to a customer S3.

If helpful I can schedule a short follow-up with our security engineer (Markus) to walk through the audit log schema and pen-test mapping.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-4821
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura@kilnpay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Dirk Roos <dirk.roos@kilnpay.com>, secops@kilnpay.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance recap & evidence + DPA / pen test asks
Attachments: kilnpay_vendor_q.pdf

Grace — appreciate the clear recap. Attaching our vendor questionnaire (PDF). Quick replies inline: 

- Retention: 13 months for transactional logs, 36 months for aggregated metrics. We do want immutability for forensic snapshots on request (legal hold).
- Pen test: we can share a redacted 2025 report (see attached). It will be redacted for customer-identifying PII.
- DPA: we require subprocessor 30-day notice and an ability to request removal for critical subprocessors; our legal team will mark up your draft.

We would like the follow-up call with Markus — can you do Thu 8am PT? Dirk, can you confirm?

Thanks,
Laura
Director, InfoSec — KilnPay
laura@kilnpay.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@kilnpay.com>, Dirk Roos <dirk.roos@kilnpay.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo compliance recap & evidence + DPA / pen test asks

Markus / Aditya — forwarding the KilnPay responses and questionnaire attached. Highlights for our prep: 

1) Retention ask: 13 months transactional logs, 36 months aggregated metrics. Also legal-hold immutability on request.
2) Pen test: they will provide a redacted 2025 report (attached as kilnpay-pen-test-2025-redacted.pdf). They want our mapping of mitigations to their findings.
3) DPA: they require 30-day subprocessor notice and removal rights for critical subprocessors.

Could Markus run a 20-minute prep with me before the call Thu 8am PT to review export formats and the exact audit-log fields they expect? Aditya — can you surface our current policy text for legal-hold retention and S3 export instructions (short blurb)?

Proposed short agenda for Thu
- 5m intro and context
- 10m audit-log schema & export walkthrough (Markus)
- 5m DPA high-level & next steps (Grace)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Grace

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura@kilnpay.com>, Dirk Roos <dirk.roos@kilnpay.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo compliance recap & evidence + DPA / pen test asks

Grace / team — noted. I reviewed the KilnPay questionnaire and their redacted pen test. Two quick notes before the Thu call: 

- Our audit logs support per-tenant JSON export with fields: timestamp, request_id, model_id, user_id_hash (pseudonymized), token_count, action, ip_geo (region), retention_tag. We can support S3 export on a monthly cadence, and on-demand snapshots for legal-hold.
- For immutability we propose: export to customer-owned S3 with Object Lock enabled (governance mode) for requested legal-holds; operational runbook required.
- Pen test mapping: I will prepare a short mapping doc (one pager) that aligns each KilnPay finding to our mitigation/control and remediation status.

I can do Thu 8am PT — sending calendar invite.

-Markus
